newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana stock exchange index rises on week.
newsitem.headline: Ghana stock exchange index rises on week.

text.p: Ghana Stock Exchange's All-Share index ended the week higher, boosted by market heavyweight Ashanti Goldfields Company, Kumasi Brewery Limited and the financial sector, its market report showed.
The GSE All-Share index closed 1.71 points higher on Friday at 369.58 points, up on the previous Friday's close of 367.22 points and 362.88 points one week earlier.
A brisk 109,380 shares were traded in Friday's session. Bids far outstripped offers by 5,304,180 to 371,280 -- maintaining a trend that has dominated the market for months.
Ashanti, which rose 150 cedis the previous Friday, added a further 50 cedis on Friday to close the week at 21,550 cedis.
Kumasi Brewery added 80 cedis on Monday and closed the week at 800.
In the financial sector, Ghana Commercial Bank rose 10 cedis on Friday and on the week to 610. Enterprise Insurance Company rose 14 on the week to close at 500.

Home Finance Company, Ghana's biggest mortgage lender which said this week it would issue a second tranche of its successful dollar-indexed corporate bond before the end of July, rose five to 145 on Friday.
Friday's other risers were Super Paper Products Company Limited, up 10 on the week to 105, and consumer products manufacturer Unilever, up nine to 847.
Pharmaceutical and trading company Paterson Zochonis fell both on Wednesday and Friday, shedding nine on the week to close at 240.
The cedi fell in value on the week from 1,915 to the U.S. dollar to 1,939.
